title: My Own Habits
grammar: Recap: szokott + infinitive and giving an opinion
goal: I can say what I usually do for nature with szokott + infinitive.
I can give my opinion with véleményem szerint and úgy gondolom, hogy.
I can talk about my habits with four new words, such as hulladékcsökkentés and helyi termelő.
I can say why I buy from local producers.
